method: 20 exact-validated boss games, fixed t0,5,10,20,30,40,60,80 when present; plus two fixed boss-side multi-cell examples. Public pre-turn states only, NOISE=0, fresh bot per state, 60000ms ample budget. No recorded opponent actions are supplied to candidate decisions. Every action legal and input unchanged; disabled current must equal frozen v07. Timings include host/JIT effects and are not nominal-budget or process-readiness evidence. Action changes are mechanism observations, not strength results.
